# FTW Global (beta) — probability rasters 2025

> 7,467 two-band (field, boundary) uint8 probability COGs at 2.5 m for 2025. CC-BY-4.0.

Data: `https://data.source.coop/ftw/global-data-beta/raster/2025/{tile_key}.tif`
Index: https://data.source.coop/ftw/global-data-beta/index/raster.parquet
Collection: https://data.source.coop/ftw/global-data-beta/raster/2025/collection.json

Probability = pixel value / 255. See AGENTS.md beside this file.
